messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed an unexpected line on the Mar 02 APAC invoice for project `redwood-dedicated-apac`. Line key: `accelerator_rate_override`, charged $12,480. Invoice ID inv-2024-03-02-APAC. Anyone else seeing this?

billing-bot: New invoice uploaded: <https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/inv-2024-03-02-APAC|inv-2024-03-02-APAC>. Detected metadata: `price_override=true`, `source=partner_integration`.

alex: Can you paste the raw export line and charge IDs? Also tagging finance-team to consider holding payment — @sam?

maya: ```
accelerator_rate_override, sku:GPU_A100_80GB, usage_hours:3120, unit_price_override:4.00, total:12480.00, override_reason:partner_promo_apac, applied_by:automation@partnerbilling, charge_id:ch_0A3bY9
```

priya: Wait — `applied_by` is the external partner automation we enabled for reseller promos. We only planned a limited canary last week; this looks like a wide match.

derek: Confirming — we flipped the partner billing webhook live 2024-03-01 03:12 UTC. There's a faulty condition in the rule engine that matched all APAC accelerator SKUs and applied the flat override. Rolling rollback now.

sam: Can finance put a hold on paying inv-2024-03-02-APAC? Need to prevent money moving to partner until this is sorted. @alex please advise.

alex: Putting payment on hold now. Creating internal hold reference PAYHLD-313. Need an estimate of delta vs expected for accounting.

maya: Delta is ~ $12.48k on that invoice, mostly charged to committed pool `apac-dedicated-1`. Not recurring unless partner promos reapply.

billing-bot: Payment hold placed by finance-team (user: alex). Invoice status updated to `PAYMENT_HOLD`.

priya: I'll open an infra PR to remove the override flag from the partner flow and add stricter matching. Also adding a unit test to the rule engine to catch region-wide matches.

derek: Rollback complete at 2024-03-02T03:40Z. I pushed a compensating fix to the webhook. We should reprocess the raw export to generate a credit/adjustment.

alex: I'll raise a support ticket with the cloud provider + partner (SUP-4521) requesting reprocessing or a credit. Also need the set of impacted account IDs — @maya can you dump the export and share path?

maya: Export uploaded to s3: `s3://billing-exports/apac/inv-2024-03-02-APAC/raw.json` (shared with finance and ops). Partner id in payload: `partner-zenith-42`. Includes `charge_id:ch_0A3bY9` and two other related charge ids.

sam: Created FIN-7894 to track credit request, accounting impact, and reconciliation. Assigning to @alex and @maya.

maya: Note: only the APAC dedicated pool was affected. Hosted API buckets and EU committed pools were not touched.

priya: Action items: 1) gate partner promos behind a feature flag + dry-run for 48h, 2) add alert when unit price for accelerator SKU deviates >5% from median in region, 3) add post-deploy billing export smoke test.

alex: Thanks all. If provider/partner declines credit we'll absorb this once and escalate contract terms with partner-zenith-42. Keeping thread open until credit confirmed. :white_check_mark:

maya: FYI I added a note to the invoice in accounting system: "PR DO NOT PAY until FIN-7894 resolved".

derek: Also adding commit link to the rollback PR: <https://git.redwood.internal/infra/commit/8f3a1f2>.

alex: Will update once SUP-4521 gets a response.

priya: +1 on the monitoring alerts. I'll file the infra follow-ups after lunch. :coffee:

sam: Thanks everyone — closing the immediate ops loop but keeping FIN-7894 open. :lock:
